parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
    SELECT
        $1::jsonb AS payload,
        $2::text AS source_filename
),
new_document AS (
    INSERT INTO energy.utility_documents (
        source_filename,
        billing_month,
        parser_version,
        parsed_scope,
        payload
    )
    SELECT
        source_filename,
        ((payload #>> '{document,billing_month}') || '-01')::date,
        payload ->> 'parser_version',
        payload ->> 'parsed_scope',
        payload
    FROM input
    RETURNING id, billing_month, payload
),
new_readings AS (
    INSERT INTO energy.utility_meter_readings (
        document_id,
        resource,
        meter_number,
        zone,
        unit,
        previous_value,
        current_value,
        reading_date
    )
    SELECT
        d.id,
        r.resource,
        r.meter_number,
        r.zone,
        r.unit,
        r.previous_value,
        r.current_value,
        r.reading_date
    FROM new_document AS d
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(
        d.payload -> 'meter_readings'
    ) AS r(
        resource text,
        meter_number text,
        zone text,
        unit text,
        previous_value numeric,
        current_value numeric,
        reading_date date
    )
    RETURNING id
),
new_charges AS (
    INSERT INTO energy.utility_charges (
        document_id,
        source_label,
        service,
        scope,
        zone,
        unit,
        consumption,
        calculation_method_code,
        applied_rate,
        amount,
        recalculation,
        benefit,
        penalty,
        payable
    )
    SELECT
        d.id,
        c.source_label,
        c.service,
        c.scope,
        c.zone,
        c.unit,
        c.consumption,
        c.calculation_method_code,
        c.applied_rate,
        c.amount,
        c.recalculation,
        c.benefit,
        c.penalty,
        c.payable
    FROM new_document AS d
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(
        d.payload -> 'charges'
    ) AS c(
        source_label text,
        service text,
        scope text,
        zone text,
        unit text,
        consumption numeric,
        calculation_method_code integer,
        applied_rate numeric,
        amount numeric,
        recalculation numeric,
        benefit numeric,
        penalty numeric,
        payable numeric
    )
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT
    d.id AS document_id,
    to_char(d.billing_month, 'YYYY-MM') AS billing_month,
    d.payload ->> 'source_filename' AS source_filename,
    d.payload ->> 'source_path' AS source_path,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM new_readings) AS readings_inserted,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM new_charges) AS charges_inserted,
    'saved'::text AS status
FROM new_document AS d;
